center_label: Home Slice Pizza (1415 S Congress Ave)
thesis: Assess how Home Slice Pizza (1415 S Congress Ave, Austin, TX 78704) ranks across 1,249 shared search origins in a 10-mile radius (0.5-mile spacing, top-30 organic depth, search_this_area=false) for four core search themes: pizza restaurant, new york style pizza, pizza by the slice, and pizza takeout.
objectives: Measure top-3 and top-10 organic Maps visibility across 1,249 shared origins (10-mile radius, 0.5-mile grid spacing) for four distinct customer search themes.
Compare category discovery (pizza restaurant) against style-specific (new york style pizza), format-specific (pizza by the slice), and fulfillment-specific (pizza takeout) searches.
Distinguish genuine visibility drop-offs from Austin sister-location handoffs (More Home Slice at 1421 S Congress Ave and North Loop at 501 E 53rd St).
Identify ranks 4-10 strike zones where targeted website and profile clarity can be evaluated.
next_actions: Inspect the 216 near-miss origins (ranks 4-10) on pizza takeout (q4) in the Companion Campaigns view and compare the 1415 S Congress Ave profile against More Home Slice (1421 S Congress Ave).
Review the 240 near-miss origins on pizza restaurant (q1), 474 on new york style pizza (q2), and 482 on pizza by the slice (q3) along South Lamar, Zilker, East Austin, and Mueller.
Open the Keyword Stuffing tab in the Companion to inspect the 79 source-reviewed competitor titles and their 0-5 evidence confidence scores.
missing_evidence: Search rankings measure organic Google Maps visibility at sampled coordinates; they do not measure walk-in traffic, online ordering conversions, or revenue.

Two queries (new york style pizza and pizza takeout) each had 1 origin out of 1,249 where the provider returned fewer than 30 organic listings after retry; those 2 observations are marked as incomplete absence rather than confirmed top-30 absence.

verification_notes: Home Slice Pizza operates three distinct Austin Google Business Profiles: 1415 S Congress Ave (CID 12299280573550492680, primary), More Home Slice at 1421 S Congress Ave (CID 8169083705981921284), and 501 E 53rd St (CID 5514358989167054199).
All 4,996 coordinate-query tasks were collected on 2026-10-19 via DataForSEO Google Maps Standard Queue with depth=30, zoom=13, and search_this_area=false (.9976 total scan spend).
evidence_disclosure: User-supplied evidence; this renderer does not independently authenticate source labels or origin records. Acquisition verification requires a separate review of the underlying evidence.

themes.customer_need: Find a local pizza restaurant for dining in or ordering a whole pie.
themes.why: Primary GBP category discovery across Austin dining neighborhoods.
themes.distinct_value: Measures baseline category prominence against all Austin pizzeria styles.
themes.limitations: Broad category searches include dine-in, slice shops, and chain pizzerias; national volume is context only.

themes.distinct_value: Isolates specialty style authority from Detroit-style, Neapolitan, and national chain competitors.
themes.limitations: Searchers may type ny pizza or new york style pizza; one representative phrase is selected for the style theme.

themes.limitations: Includes both dedicated counter-service slice windows (including More Home Slice next door) and full-service pizzerias.

profile_review.identity_assessment: Verified Home Slice Pizza South Congress flagship profile (CID 12299280573550492680 at 1415 S Congress Ave, Austin, TX 78704) against the linked South Congress location page. Separate profiles for More Home Slice next door (1421 S Congress Ave) and Home Slice Pizza North Loop (501 E 53rd St) remain distinct profiles.
profile_review.website_assessment: Website evidence was retained in the study. This does not certify every customer link or transaction.
profile_review.access: Public provider observations; no private owner performance data.
profile_review.limitation: Profile fields are observations, not a profile quality score or an explanation of ranking. Missing fields are unknown. Opening hours, offerings and linked destinations may need owner confirmation.

findings.text: For 'pizza restaurant', the listing appeared among the first three results at 21 of 1249 measured locations, and among the first ten at 261.
For 'new york style pizza', the listing appeared among the first three results at 549 of 1249 measured locations, and among the first ten at 1023.
For 'pizza by the slice', the listing appeared among the first three results at 470 of 1249 measured locations, and among the first ten at 952.
For 'pizza takeout', the listing appeared among the first three results at 6 of 1249 measured locations, and among the first ten at 222.

decision_brief.reading_guide: Each dot represents a place someone could search from. Its number is the listing position returned for that search, not a customer count. Different searches can reveal different discovery gaps.
decision_brief.boundary: These observations do not establish why rankings differ, how many people searched, or whether a change will generate sales.

actions.title: Surface explicit takeout and curbside pickup details on the South Congress location page
actions.why: For pizza takeout (q4), the primary profile reaches top 3 at 6 of 1,249 origins and ranks 4-10 at 216 nearby South and Central Austin origins where it already ranks top 3 for new york style pizza and pizza by the slice.
actions.next_step: Add dedicated pizza takeout and pickup ordering copy, hours, and FAQ details to https://homeslicepizza.com/location/south-congress/ and verify GBP service attributes.
actions.success_check: Re-measure the 216 near-miss origins on q4 after page updates are indexed.
actions.uncertainty: Organic Maps rankings depend on proximity, sister-profile handoff to More Home Slice (1421 S Congress Ave), and Google relevance weighting.

actions.title: Add New York-style and slice-counter headings to the South Congress location page
actions.why: The homepage states Authentic NY-Style Pizza - by the slice or pie, and new york style pizza (549 top-3, 1,023 top-10) and pizza by the slice (470 top-3, 952 top-10) outperform broad category searches across East, West, and South Austin.
actions.next_step: Ensure the South Congress location page (/location/south-congress/) explicitly reinforces New York-style whole pies and walk-in slices in structured headings.
actions.success_check: Compare ranks 4-10 strike corridors on q2 (474 near-miss origins) and q3 (482 near-miss origins) in a follow-up scan.
actions.uncertainty: Adding on-page clarity supports relevance but does not override competitor proximity in outer neighborhoods.

actions.title: Account for North Loop sister-location handoff before targeting North Austin origins
actions.why: North of UT Campus and Hyde Park, Google Maps frequently returns the 501 E 53rd St Home Slice Pizza profile instead of the 1415 S Congress Ave profile.
actions.next_step: Evaluate combined brand coverage across all three Austin Home Slice profiles before investing in North Austin campaigns for the South Congress listing.
actions.success_check: Cross-reference North Austin origins against CID 5514358989167054199 (501 E 53rd St) in the Companion Local Leaders and Businesses views.
actions.uncertainty: Google commonly selects one branch per brand in a local search viewport when sister locations are separated by several miles.

evidence.value: Home Slice Pizza operates three distinct Austin Google Business Profiles: 1415 S Congress Ave (CID 12299280573550492680, primary), More Home Slice at 1421 S Congress Ave (CID 8169083705981921284), and 501 E 53rd St (CID 5514358989167054199).

decision_brief.authorship: Computed observations; recommendations, when supplied, are analyst judgments. Valid references do not prove an interpretation.
decision_brief.headline: Strong South and Central Austin visibility for slice and New York style searches, with a sharp fulfillment gap on pizza takeout.
decision_brief.explanation: Across 1,249 shared origins in a 10-mile radius around 1415 S Congress Ave, Home Slice Pizza achieves its broadest regional authority on new york style pizza (549 top-3 origins, 1,023 top-10, found at all 1,249 origins) and pizza by the slice (470 top-3 origins, 952 top-10), while broad category discovery (pizza restaurant) reaches top 3 at 21 South/Central origins (261 top-10). By contrast, pizza takeout reaches top 3 at only 6 origins (222 top-10, 216 near-miss ranks 4-10) despite Pizza Takeout being an explicit secondary GBP category and More Home Slice operating next door at 1421 S Congress Ave.
